description: The input module contains functionality for simulated user input.

commands.name: performActions
commands.description: Performs a specified sequence of user input actions.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The navigable in which to perform the actions.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: A list of input.SourceActions, validated by the agent.

commands.name: releaseActions
commands.description: Resets the input state associated with the current session.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: A navigable whose top-level traversable's input state is reset.

commands.name: setFiles
commands.description: Sets the files property of a given input element with type file to a set of file paths.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: A script.SharedReference to an input element.

events.name: fileDialogOpened
events.description: Fired when a file dialog is opened.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The navigable in which the dialog opened.

parameters.name: userContext
parameters.description: The user context of the navigable.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: A script.SharedReference to the file input element.

parameters.name: multiple
parameters.description: Whether the dialog allows selecting multiple files.
